name: Oklahoma
summary_text: Facility bans 2022 and 2025 plus a statutory birth-sex definition of “sex.” Large parts of the state are Public Law 280 tribal jurisdiction, where gender-recognition law varies by nation and cannot be scored at this level. Below the national score 0.36.
